title: John Mulaney Takes Manhattan: Here’s Where to Buy Affordable Comedy Tour Tickets Online
summary: The former SNL writer takes on a nine-show tour throughout New York City — starting in January 2027.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

After tour dates throughout the United States, comedian and former Saturday Night Live writer John Mulaney returns to New York City to kick off a nine-show citywide residency throughout the borough of Manhattan, as part of the Mulaney Takes Manhattan comedy tour.

The New York tour starts on Thursday, Jan. 7, 2027, at the Comedy Cellar and ends on Friday, Jan. 15, at Madison Square Garden . Additionally, each show is likely to include a surprise guest performance as an opener.

Shop John Mulaney Comedy Tickets At Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

This is a very hot ticket in comedy, so many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out. One of the best ways to find John Mulaney tickets online is through third-party retailers, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All of which guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find John Mulaney Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find John Mulaney Tickets at StubHub

find tickets here

Top choice for concert tickets in 2026-27.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. Meanwhile, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit, or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, John Mulaney tickets start at $109.

EARN REWARDS

Find John Mulaney Tickets at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front or VIP sections, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly-rated sellers.” With Vivid Seats, your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your concert, or your money back.

PROMO CODES

Find John Mulaney Tickets at SeatGeek

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap John Mulaney tickets online from $105. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

DISCOUNTS

Find John Mulaney Tickets at TicketNetwork

Don’t forget TicketNetwork . The retailer has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to John Mulaney’s concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $101, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. In fact, the company guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

SEATING OPTIONS

Find John Mulaney Tickets at Gametime

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts like John Mulaney start at $97. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket-buying experience.
